grid.reason: Matches the outcome-blind Campanula microterrain development grid and is fine enough to represent local structural heterogeneity without treating a raster cell as a field-effort unit.

range_sector_rule: Every candidate frame is clipped to the predeclared aza3 range sector for the frozen cohort unit; records outside that sector cannot silently expand the frame.

local_continuation.anchor_eligibility: frozen primary anchors only: reconciled taxon, event year 2000-2025, coordinates, no serious geospatial issue, declared uncertainty <=1000 m, sector compatible
local_continuation.primary_frame: union of 0.5-2.0 km annuli around eligible anchors inside the declared range sector, clipped to the sector
local_continuation.sensitivity_frame: union of 0.5-5.0 km annuli around the same frozen anchors, reported separately and not substituted after outcome

development_basis.interpretation: 2 km is frozen as the primary local frame because development recovery was already high while 5 km expanded nominal annular area about 6.6-fold. Cirsium field outcomes did not choose this radius.

local_continuation.anchor_replication_reporting: ZERO/SINGLE/MULTIPLE remains explicit; multiple anchors generate a union frame, not a fitted density surface.

sentinel.rule: Do not force the local annulus when primary anchors are absent. v2 occurrence evidence will decide whether declared-uncertainty kernels, coarse sector context, legacy context, or abstention is justified.

selection_count.rule: Generate a deterministic full ranking/token order per method before field outcomes. The field campaign may use a predeclared equal prefix across methods; no outcome-driven prefix extension or method-specific k is allowed.
selection_count.reason: Avoid hard-coding field days/cost into the ecological algorithm before prospective effort data exist.

boundary: Candidate-cell count and geometry are not field effort. Matched field search time/observer effort remains a prospective validation requirement.
